epochPolicy.pre: Only observations with UTC and local calendar dates safely before April 1, 2026
epochPolicy.post: Only observations with UTC and local calendar dates safely on or after April 3, 2026
epochPolicy.quarantine: UTC interval [2026-04-01T00:00:00Z,2026-04-03T00:00:00Z), plus any observation locally dated April 1 or April 2; crossing cohorts also quarantined
epochPolicy.caution: Safety buffer chosen because Blizzard's official April 1 dated entry has no deployment hour or region; it is NOT a measured deployment window
epochPolicy.unknown: Invalid or missing timestamps rejected; not assigned pre or post

context: observationStart and observationEnd ISO timestamps with timezone
inputContract.events: Each completed cast has distinct castID, zero-inclusive outputCount and refundedInputUnits; aborted cast has neither. No aggregate inventory is silently converted to cast count.
inputContract.outputUniverse: Only marginal output 242608; complete economic output universe remains unverified.

functions.classifyEpoch: Strict Gregorian timezone parsing; quarantine April 1-2 in UTC and local dates, and any cohort crossing classifications.
functions.analyzeCohort: Computes observed P=positive completed casts/completed casts and unconditional E=total output including zeros/completed casts; gross, refunded and net inputs separate; observed positive extrema are not hard bounds.
functions.compareEpochs: Requires same profession/rank/recipe profile and different source lineage AND study-family ID; raw pre/post only; descriptive differences without causal hotfix coefficient.

applicability: Research-only, typed fixed context. Hotfix establishes nonstationarity risk, not a measured baseline. Unknown skill, unlock, cast denominator, recipe eligibility or complete output universe blocks numeric transfer and economic use.

uncertainty.sourceTiming: Official April 1 dated entry lacks deployment hour or region; conservative two-calendar-day quarantine is a safety assumption, not evidence.
uncertainty.comparisonConfounding: Patch/build and source-family effects not eliminated by matched profile alone.
uncertainty.noIndependentCohorts: Zero actual source logs ingested; synthetic demonstrations only.
uncertainty.noHardYieldCap: No finite cap asserted from observed positive extrema.

modelSelfTestV8.method: Exact committed CommonJS source executed with a strict-assert shim in V8

evidenceResearcherRequest: For seven exact stable keys, obtain independent post-April-3 current-Retail zero-inclusive completed-cast logs with all ranks, skill/spec/gear/unlocks/refunds, exact build and timezone timestamps; do not infer a gem-specific rate change from the April 1 note.
independentValidatorRequest: Independently confirm official April 1 heading, execute exact v1.0.1 model natively, challenge UTC/local timezone boundary classification and cross-epoch study-family independence, and keep all P/E and gold promotions blocked.
blockers: Exact deployment hour/region on April 1, 2026 unknown; quarantine is a conservative assumption
No independent current-Retail zero-inclusive completed-cast logs for seven keys
